default.notes: Visitor visa (subclass 600) required — apply online through ImmiAccount before travelling. Allow several weeks for processing.

groups.notes: Apply online for the FREE eVisitor (subclass 651). It is valid for 12 months and allows stays of up to 3 months per visit — never pay a third-party site for it.

Apply for the Electronic Travel Authority (subclass 601) via the official Australian ETA app — AUD 20 service charge, usually approved within minutes. Stays of up to 3 months per visit during its 12-month validity.

AU.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Australian citizens.

NZ.notes: New Zealand citizens are granted a Special Category Visa (subclass 444) automatically on arrival under the Trans-Tasman Travel Arrangement — no application or fee. It allows visiting, living and working in Australia indefinitely while you remain a NZ citizen.
